purpose: Document first-party Beijing registry context and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review for Changping.
assessment: Beijing's official planning and natural-resources authority documents municipal cadastral-map and parcel-map query services, and the official Beijing Tianditu portal provides public geospatial service resources. The local registry entry point timed out for bounded anonymous GET requests; no safe Changping parcel geometry, schema, CRS, or native ID was verified.
registryAssessment: Local/municipal registry custodian verified: 北京市规划和自然资源委员会 (Beijing Municipal Commission of Planning and Natural Resources), with its official real-estate registration platform and cadastral-map query procedures evidenced. Changping-specific anonymous parcel coverage remains unverified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Chinese notice says anyone may query Beijing cadastral districts/sub-districts and that parcel-map lookup can return parcel code, real-estate unit number, location, area, rights type, and attached map; owner/interest-holder inquiry is separately controlled.
Official Chinese announcement describes the visual real-estate/cadastral-map query platform and identifies the official online service entry; visual lookup uses identity verification routes.
Official English government translation corroborates the Beijing cadastral-map visualization service and its access method.

Official Beijing Tianditu service-resource page, operated by the Beijing planning/natural-resources authority and Beijing Institute of Surveying and Mapping; public map/API resources were visible, but no verified parcel feature service was established.
